# `openpyxl.worksheet.copier`

## `WorksheetCopy`

```python
WorksheetCopy(source_worksheet, target_worksheet)
```

Copy the values, styles, dimensions, merged cells, margins, and
print/page setup from one worksheet to another within the same
workbook.

### `copy_worksheet`

```python
copy_worksheet()
```

### `source`

```python
source = source_worksheet
```

### `target`

```python
target = target_worksheet
```
